description: Eventi del traffico is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Lavori in corso, deviazioni o chiusure della rete ciclabile sovracomunale. Il dataset è in continuo aggiornamento in collaborazione con le Unità Comprensoriali. Coverage: Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. The portal files it under the publisher Provincia autonoma di Bolzano. Its tags are bicicletta, chiusura, deviazione, eu, lavori-in-corso. It offers 3 resource(s) in MAP_SRVC, OP_DATPRO. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
